segments.name: Public Cloud

segments.evidence: Our operations are organized into two segments: Hybrid Cloud and Public Cloud.

revenueModel.text: Large organizations pay NetApp for data storage software, hardware, and related support, professional and other services.

changes.text: In fiscal 2025 NetApp sold its Spot by NetApp cloud optimization and management software business, which was part of the Public Cloud segment.
changes.evidence: During fiscal 2025, we completed the sale of our cloud optimization and management software business known as Spot by NetApp to Flexera Software LLC.
